title: Maximum Size of Accessory Group Parking Facilities
previewText:
C1 C2 C3 C4 C5 C6 C7 C8

In all districts, as indicated, no accessory group parking facility to residences shall contain more than 200 off-street parking spaces, and no such facility accessory to permitted community facility or commercial uses shall contain more than 150 off-street parking spaces, except as provided in Section 36-13 (Modification of Maximum Size of Accessory Group Parking Facilities).
